_comment: StageRank reads this file to find where to send anonymous usage reports. Installed copies follow changes made here, so the endpoint can move without asking anyone to update.
note: Not live yet. Until a real endpoint is published here, reports are queued locally and never leave the organiser's server.

partner_ids._comment: The partner ids every installed copy carries on its payment requests. Blank until a contract exists with that provider; an organiser can override any of these with the STAGERANK_*_ID environment variables, and their value always wins.
